name: Tertiary Access Payment
summary: A one-off payment for regional and remote school leavers who move away for full-time study.
key: $3,000 for inner regional students. Up to $5,000 for outer regional and remote students, paid as $3,000 then $2,000.
numbers: $3,000, paid once after enrolment is confirmed
Up to $5,000: $3,000 after the first census date, $2,000 after the second
who: Study at Certificate IV level or above, at least 75% of a full-time load, lasting at least a year.
22 or under when you start, and moving to a provider at least 90 minutes by public transport from the family home.
Parents' or guardians' combined income of $250,000 or less, unless an exemption applies.
how: Apply through Services Australia within your first year of tertiary study.
catches: One official page says you must start the year after Year 12. Another says students who take a break may now qualify. We are checking which applies.
The page does not say whether the current round is open.
